document_title: Software Requirements Specification for English Learning App

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: The English Learning App project aims to address the challenges faced by students of all ages in improving their English language skills for future education. The app will provide a personalized learning experience tailored to the needs of high school students preparing for college entrance exams, adult professionals seeking career advancement, and ESL students. By integrating real-world contexts, gamified learning, and personalized feedback, the app seeks to enhance language proficiency effectively.

subsections.title: Purpose
subsections.content: The purpose of this Software Requirements Specification (SRS) document is to define the functional and non-functional requirements of the English Learning App. It outlines the scope of the project, identifies key features, and provides a detailed analysis of the market landscape and competitive positioning.

subsections.title: Document Conventions
subsections.content: This document follows the IEEE standard format for Software Requirements Specifications. Functional requirements are denoted by 'FR-XXX', non-functional requirements by 'NFR-XXX', and MVP scope features by 'MVP-XXX'.

subsections.title: Intended Audience and Reading Suggestions
subsections.content: The primary audience for this document includes developers, project managers, testers, and stakeholders involved in the development of the English Learning App. Developers should refer to the functional requirements for implementation guidance, while project managers can use the document to track project progress. Testers can derive test cases from the requirements outlined here. Stakeholders should review the market analysis and competitive landscape sections for strategic insights.

subsections.title: Product Scope
subsections.content: The English Learning App is a software application designed to help users improve their English language skills through interactive lessons, progress tracking, and personalized learning experiences. The app targets high school students preparing for college entrance exams, adult professionals seeking career advancement, and ESL students looking to enhance their language proficiency. By focusing on real-world context integration, gamified learning, and personalized feedback, the app aims to provide an engaging and effective platform for language learning.

subsections.title: Product Perspective
subsections.content: The English Learning App is a standalone application designed to provide personalized English language learning experiences for high school students preparing for college entrance exams. It is not a replacement for existing systems but aims to address the limitations of current language learning tools by focusing on tailored learning approaches.

subsections.title: Product Functions
subsections.content:
Major functions of the English Learning App include:
- Intuitive user interface for seamless navigation
- Progress tracking to monitor learning improvement
- Choice of learning difficulty to cater to individual proficiency levels

subsections.title: User Classes and Characteristics
subsections.content:
User classes include:
- High school students preparing for college entrance exams
- Adult professionals seeking career advancement
- ESL students

Characteristics:
- High school students: Medium urgency, need for academic success
- Adult professionals: Low urgency, focus on job opportunities
- ESL students: Medium urgency, importance for daily communication

subsections.title: Operating Environment
subsections.content: The English Learning App is designed to operate on major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) on desktop and mobile devices. It must work with the latest versions of these browsers to ensure compatibility and accessibility for users.

subsections.title: Design and Implementation Constraints
subsections.content:
Regulatory policies: Compliance with data privacy regulations for user data protection
Hardware limitations: Optimal performance on devices with at least 2GB RAM
Technology constraints: Integration with external APIs for language learning resources

subsections.title: User Documentation
subsections.content:
User documentation will include:
- User manuals for app navigation and features
- Help section for troubleshooting common issues
- Tutorials for utilizing advanced functionalities like progress tracking

subsections.title: Assumptions and Dependencies
subsections.content:
Assumptions:
- Users have basic proficiency in operating web and mobile applications
- Stable internet connection for real-time progress tracking
Dependencies:
- Availability of language learning resources for content integration
- Support from Vue developers for app maintenance and updates

external_interfaces.title: External Interface Requirements
external_interfaces.content: This section describes external interface requirements.

subsections.title: User Interfaces
subsections.content: Describe UI characteristics, screen layouts, navigation, accessibility requirements. The English Learning App must have an intuitive user interface (UI) design that allows high school students to navigate the app effortlessly. Screen layouts should be clear and user-friendly, with easy access to all features from the main menu. Instructions within the app should be concise and provide clear guidance for each feature.

subsections.title: Hardware Interfaces
subsections.content: Describe hardware the software interacts with. The English Learning App does not have specific hardware interface requirements as it is primarily a software application designed for mobile and desktop devices. It should be compatible with standard hardware configurations commonly used by high school students, such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers.

subsections.title: Software Interfaces
subsections.content: Describe connections to other software, databases, APIs, libraries. The English Learning App may require connections to external services for features like progress tracking, content delivery, and user authentication. It should integrate with databases to store user data securely. APIs may be used for language processing or external content retrieval. Libraries for UI components and data visualization may also be utilized.

subsections.title: Communications Interfaces
subsections.content: Network protocols, data formats, security requirements. The English Learning App must adhere to secure communication protocols to protect user data during transmission. It should support standard data formats for interoperability with external systems. Security requirements include encryption of user data both in transit and at rest to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of user information.

system_features.name: Intuitive User Interface
system_features.description: Provides an easy-to-use interface for seamless navigation
system_features.stimulus_response: User opens the app -> Main menu displayed with clear options

functional_requirements.description: The app must have an easy-to-use interface with intuitive navigation and clear instructions to cater to high school students.
The UI must follow best practices for intuitive navigation and clear labeling.

system_features.name: Progress Tracking
system_features.description: Allows users to monitor their learning progress over time
system_features.stimulus_response: User completes a lesson -> Progress dashboard updates with lesson completion status

functional_requirements.description: The app must allow users to track their learning progress, including completed lessons, quiz scores, and overall improvement.
The app must load within 3 seconds on average.

system_features.name: Choose Learning Difficulty
system_features.description: Enables users to select the difficulty level of lessons
system_features.stimulus_response: User starts a lesson -> Prompt to choose difficulty level appears

functional_requirements.description: The app must allow users to choose the difficulty level of lessons based on their proficiency to cater to different learning needs.
The app must be compatible with major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) on desktop and mobile devices.

subsections.title: Performance Requirements
subsections.content: - NFR-PERF-001: The app must load within 3 seconds on average.

subsections.title: Safety Requirements
subsections.content: - NFR-SAFE-001: No specific safety requirements identified for the English Learning App.

subsections.title: Security Requirements
subsections.content:
- NFR-SEC-001: User data must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.
- NFR-SEC-002: No sensitive user data should be stored on the device.

subsections.title: Software Quality Attributes
subsections.content:
- NFR-QUAL-001: The app must have a system in place for automated backups and data recovery.
- NFR-QUAL-002: The UI must follow best practices for intuitive navigation and clear labeling.

subsections.title: Business Rules
subsections.content: - NFR-BUS-001: The app must not collect any personally identifiable information without user consent.

glossary.Phrasal Verb: A combination of verb and one or more particles (prepositions, adverbs) that conveys a unique meaning.
glossary.Mispronunciation: Incorrect pronunciation of a word or phrase.
glossary.Cognitive Overload: The mental burden experienced when trying to process and retain too much information at once.
glossary.Gamified Learning: Educational approach that incorporates game elements to engage and motivate learners.
glossary.Personalized Feedback: Tailored guidance and suggestions based on individual learner's performance.
glossary.Immersive Learning: An educational method that involves deeply engaging learners in the learning process.
glossary.Freemium Model: A business model offering basic services for free while charging for premium features.
glossary.Subscription-based Model: A pricing model where users pay a recurring fee for continued access to a service.
glossary.Structured Curriculum: A planned sequence of learning activities designed to achieve specific educational goals.
glossary.Conversational Practice: Engaging in dialogue or conversation to improve language speaking skills.
